what_was_done: Frontend: futuristic fonts (Outfit/Unbounded), glassmorphic tokens, cyberpunk colors, 3D holographic Bob orb.
CSS overhaul: base (scan animations), topbar (floating pills), chat (glassmorphic bubbles), cards (hover scale), charts (staggered load), sdca (tactile console), indicators (neon veto).
Pipeline: removed hard ticker requirement for vague financial prompts — 3-layer fix in intents, orchestrator, sdca_firewall.
Deterministic parser now routes vague financials to market_scan instead of needs_scope.
Orchestrator guard prevents CEO model from downgrading market_scan to needs_scope.
SDCA firewall hard-blocks only for real trading decisions with ticker present.
Signal ledger: collector, policy, resolve, report, append_from_ndjson scripts + schema + docs + tests.
Runtime checkpoint restored with runtime_parameters contract.

commands: python -m pytest tests/ -q -> 670/671 passed (1 pre-existing fixed now)
python -m ruff check src/ -> all passed
curl POST /task/submit 'quero uma dica de investimento' -> market_scan, 10 candidates, SDCA ALLOW, CEO volume anomaly shortlist

risks.description: CSS animations can cause GPU/CPU usage on older machines.
CEO intent classifier cold-start timeout may cause deterministic_final fallback on first request.
risks.mitigation: Deterministic parser now returns safe non-blocking routes.

risks.description: Signal ledger is offline-only; no external integrations yet.
risks.mitigation: All paths are disk-only per GITHUB_POLICY.

next_step: Operator review of live dashboard with non-ticker financial prompts and signal ledger audit.
